title: Family Yoga and Meditation Night
venue_name: Science of Spirituality International Meditation Center
description:
Join us for Family Yoga and Meditation Night, where mindfulness meets movement! Perfect for ages 6+, this rejuvenating event combines physical yoga to energize your body and SOS Meditation to nurture your spiritual health. 

Experience quality family time while enhancing mental clarity, emotional balance, and overall well-being. Don't miss this chance to embrace peace and connection together!

All are Welcome. Program is free of charge.
